values: 一名擅长深入敌后的辅助，能够潜伏在敌方阵营为友军提供支援。
A Support who excels at infiltrating enemy lines and assisting allies from the enemy side of the battlefield.
It's an honor to work with you.
嗯……情报收集完毕，是时候收网了。
Hmm... intel collected. Time to close the net.
密使不应暴露喜好，但此次该无妨。谢谢，我很喜欢。
An envoy mustn't show favoritism... but this time, I'll make an exception. Thank you.
感谢你的心意，合作愉快。
向往她的理性与从容，以她的高贵与权柄为己身的荣光。
Emulate her composure and embody her authority.
偶尔也放下繁重的工作，睡个好觉吧。
You deserve a break every now and then.

This place is more comfortable than the club in Savannah.
Time to relax for a while.
没问题，我可以再来一杯
No problem. I can have another glass.
伊芙年纪不大，行事作风却比许多年长的事务官更加谨慎、周全。王室中与她政见不合的大臣甚至私下怀疑，她是否隐瞒了年龄。

Despite her youth, Evie approaches her duties with more caution and care than many of her senior colleagues. Some ministers at odds with her often privately speculate that she may be hiding her actual age.
“家庭情况？我的父亲担任市政厅事务官，负责文书相关工作；母亲从事考古研究，现就职于冬青学会。”——伊芙参与市政厅事务官面试时的回答。
"My family? Well, my father serves as an administrative officer at the town council, and my mother is an archaeologist with the Evergreen Conservatory." —An interview with Evie
从父亲身上，伊芙学会了如何快速、巧妙、严谨且精准地处理文本事务。而母亲则教会了她如何多线程工作，并且做到“效率”和“质量”并存。
Evie learned to handle paperwork meticulously from her father, while her mother taught her to multitask without sacrificing quality.
伊芙在政界初露头角时，曾被人视作眼中钉，将她拖入一场危险的辩论。整整三个小时，她的发言始终未露出一点破绽，对方只好作罢。
When Evie first rose to prominence in political circles, her adversaries quickly perceived her as a threat and challenged her to an intense three-hour debate. She prevailed with flawless arguments.
王后将伊芙调任至自己麾下，正式任命她为特使团成员那天，伊芙无比激动，罕见地打破了为自律定下的规矩，一晚上连吃了三块蛋糕。
The day the Queen appointed Evie as her special envoy was the happiest of her life. In her joy, she abandoned her usual strict diet and indulged in three slices of cake in a single night.
“母亲，你新招募的那位叫伊芙的特使很厉害哦！举止利落、谈吐大方又滴水不漏，一点都不像新人。”——佩吉公主如此向王后说到。
"Mother, I'm impressed by your new special envoy, Evie! She's too sharp and poised to be a newcomer!" —Princess Peggy to the Queen
伊芙的衣柜基本以暗色调、简洁风格的衣服为主。除了密使的工作所需，最大的原因是：她不太擅长服装搭配。
Evie favors dark, minimalist clothing, partly due to the covert nature of her work, and partly because fashion just isn't her strong suit.
“这世上没有任何人能绝对保守秘密。即使本人不曾开口，那人的行为举止、一举一动，哪怕是一个细微的表情，都会替他说出实情。”——伊芙的情报日志。
"No one can keep a secret forever. Even without words, their actions and expressions will give them away." —Evie's journal
为了更好地完成调查任务，伊芙向宫廷魔法师学习了一些简单的魔法。从此，她身边出现了一个如影随形的好伙伴：那根神出鬼没的魔法羽毛笔。
To better execute her missions, Evie learned basic spellcraft from the court mages and acquired a new companion, an enchanted quill that comes and goes at will.
伊芙为王室服务，更为王后服务。在她心目中，王后是整个王室里最理性、最优雅、最具领导力之人。能够追随王后，对她来说就是最高的荣耀。

Evie serves the royal family, but above all, the Queen. In her eyes, none within the royal household rivals Her Majesty in reason, grace, or command. To follow Her Majesty is the greatest honor of her life.
说到打探情报的技巧，我认为最简单的做法，就是买通线人。金币往桌上一放，嘴巴就会自己张开。
Now, as for intel gathering, sure, the simplest method is to grease a few palms. Drop a gold coin or two, and lips start flapping.
这些香料的品质很不错……不愧是霍尔特商街。
These spices are excellent quality... no surprise, coming from Holt Street.
真巧，这不是替霍根将军暂时代管骑士团日常事务的维伦先生吗。
Ah, if it isn't Sir Valen, General Hogan's trusted right hand. The very man overseeing the daily affairs of the Heroic Order.
仇恨有时比信念更简单。
Sometimes, hating is easier than believing in something.
